about: Step invariants (src/story-invariants.mjs) a test run finds today, each with why. The runner fails on any other; the list only shrinks.

entries.why: By design: whether a version's opening reached the shared branch is unknown while the remote cannot be read, and the route is to settle the same operation again once it answers (osa-stage2-journey-h.test.mjs). A retry later, never a second opening.
